reasoning: The 362.067 to 362.133 edit hides the actual DeSimone conversation, so the NPC coordinate remains an estimate. The first visible post-handoff player is at the north camp with the Forean Initiates, and the north-camp-to-cave navmesh route is complete. The old south placement required an unsupported 115 m return trip from that camp. Positioning DeSimone near the post-edit player better fits the observed sequence and the original mission text naming him as receiver/giver.

route_probe.limit: Navmesh path is simplified navigation, not a native-client walk or proof of original NPC location.

remaining_unverified: DeSimone is not visible during the edited original conversation; exact final-live position and orientation remain unknown.
The native client opened and completed the objective at the revised emulator position, but a continuous original-style Hartmann to DeSimone to cave playthrough remains unverified.
Forean companions are still absent from the emulator; this placement alone does not restore original encounter support.

After a short ordinary movement away from the NPC, the native talk prompt appeared.

Continue awarded 500 XP and changed the tracker to Find a way out of the cave.
Copied saved mission 1994 has objective 4 status 2 complete and objective 2 status 1 incomplete.
